technical_and_design_decisions: Use standard Spring Integration / WebSocket messaging components to construct the native WebSocket sink for full-duplex TCP communications.
Utilize Hadoop FileSystem API to interact with HDFS for hosting and fetching custom module uber-jars dynamically at container startup.
Implement child-first classloader isolation strategy for custom modules to resolve version conflicts with shared libraries in 'xd/lib'.
Configure Gradle test tasks in CI with maxParallelForks and execution via wrapper scripts ('./gradlew') rather than direct Artifactory tasks.
Use PowerShell scripts on Windows Bamboo agents to manage background services (Redis, RabbitMQ) and execute integration tests.
assumptions: HDFS cluster, EC2 build instances, and Bamboo Windows CI agents are already provisioned and accessible.
SonarQube server is operational and capable of sending notifications to committers via email or webhooks.
Development and execution environments run on Java 17+ as specified by Spring Framework 6.0+ standards.
Redis and RabbitMQ installers or silent packages are available for automated Windows setup.

activities.activity_description: Author user documentation covering recommended standards, architectural patterns, packaging practices, and guidelines for custom module creation (U1).

activities.activity_name: HDFS Custom Module Hosting & Deployment Support
activities.activity_description: Implement feature to store uber-jar custom modules in HDFS and configure container provisioning logic to pull modules from HDFS upon container arrival (U2).
Develop and unit test a native WebSocket sink module enabling full-duplex communication over single TCP connections (U3).
Research and integrate dependency caching mechanisms (e.g., npm-cache or Gradle build cache) into CI build scripts to reduce download overhead (U4).
Update EC2 CI configuration to enable distributed JVM tests, switch to ./gradlew command execution, disable embedded Hadoop during test runs, and enable maxParallelForks (U5).
Investigate WARN log spikes, resolve existing PMD/Sonar code quality violations, and configure Sonar notifications to alert committers on new violations (U6).

activities.activity_name: Windows OS CI Automation Pipeline Setup
activities.activity_description: Configure Windows Bamboo agent, write PowerShell setup scripts for required services (Redis, RabbitMQ), and establish automated commit-triggered integration test runs (U7).
Establish the shared 'xd/lib' dependency folder support and implement classloader isolation handling to allow custom modules to bundle specific library versions when needed (U8).
Perform comprehensive integration testing across all updated CI pipelines, custom module deployments from HDFS, WebSocket sink flows, and classloading scenarios.
